fusions.name: Ricochet Hatchet
fusions.desc: Flips a hatchet that deals 4 damage to the first enemy it meets, then glances to 1 more enemy within 3 tiles for 60% of that damage.

fusions.name: Wrist Snatch
fusions.desc: Snatches at the target's weapon arm and chops, dealing 12 damage, stunning it for 1 second, and leaving it [Hindered] for 5 seconds and 10% easier to wound for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Sleight of Hand
fusions.desc: Clears the cooldown on one of your other abilities, chosen at random from those still waiting. Your movement speed rises 20% for 4 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: Duck and Return
fusions.desc: Every blow you avoid builds a stack on you, up to 4. The next ability you use spends them all: you deal 6% more damage per stack (24% at full) for 6 seconds. Unfed, a stack fades every 6 seconds.
